trust_decision.summary: Untrusted OLE/CFB EncryptionInfo/EncryptedPackage stream bytes and the agile XML header fields they hold (header size, KeySize, KeyBits, BlockSize, hashAlgorithm, salt/IV lengths, ciphertext length) are used as slice bounds, key/IV lengths and divisors without validation in crypt.go's decrypt helpers. The panics are not recovered anywhere on the Decrypt/OpenFile/OpenReader path.

landing_point.why: The summary names the Decrypt API on malformed OLE/CFB encrypted workbooks. Decrypt is the public function, and it dispatches to agileDecrypt and standardDecrypt in the same file.

fix_sites.entry_point: excelize.Decrypt / OpenFile / OpenReader (standard mechanism), header length and header size bounds
excelize.Decrypt / OpenFile / OpenReader (standard mechanism), verifier blob length before standardEncryptionVerifier slices
excelize.Decrypt / OpenFile / OpenReader (standard mechanism), EncryptedPackage length and block multiple (guard placed at function entry, fix.diff:13)
excelize.Decrypt (standard), also called internally by Encrypt via standardKeyEncryption (crypt.go:391-394), KeySize whitelist
excelize.Decrypt / OpenFile / OpenReader (agile mechanism), EncryptionInfo shorter than 8 bytes
excelize.Decrypt (agile), the error from decrypt of the key value was discarded
excelize.Decrypt (agile), unknown hashAlgorithm gives an empty key, and KeyBits is not whitelisted
excelize.Decrypt (agile), key pad appends 0x36 zero bytes instead of padding to keyBytes with 0x36
excelize.Decrypt (agile, key value and package chunks), IV length and input block multiple before CryptBlocks
excelize.Decrypt (agile), BlockSize must be 16 and ciphertext a block multiple; chunk zero-padding removed (divide by zero on BlockSize 0)
excelize.Decrypt (agile, per chunk), BlockSize <= 0, empty hash, and IV pad to exact BlockSize with 0x36

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: crypt.go:305-329 (standardConvertPasswdToKey, shared with the Encrypt/save path at crypt.go:391-394) and crypt.go:513-519 (decrypt, the shared AES-CBC primitive). Both are in the same file as the landing point, so the out-of-scope appearance is weak.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The key and IV padding sites (crypt.go:465-471, crypt.go:584-590) look like a cosmetic correctness bug in the length of the padding, not a crash. The 0x36 padding produces a wrong-length key or IV that only panics later inside cipher.NewCBCDecrypter, so a solver can argue it is a feature fix, not the panic.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate encrypted workbooks must still open and round-trip: SHA1/SHA512 agile files with the right password, the wrong-password error path, and Encrypt/SaveAs with a password (which calls standardConvertPasswdToKey with KeySize 128). The existing test also expects createIV with MD5 and BlockSize 32 to succeed, which the fix keeps and makes pad correctly with 0x36. An over-broad fix (rejecting BlockSize != 16 in createIV, failing on short hashes, or validating standard headers strictly enough to break Encrypt) breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: standard: encryptionHeaderSize < 32 or larger than the buffer
standard: verifier blob shorter than the AES (72) or RC4 (60) layout
standard: EncryptedPackage shorter than 8 bytes or not a 16-byte multiple
agile: unknown or empty hashAlgorithm (empty key/IV)
agile: salt/IV length not equal to the AES block size, or key value not a block multiple
agile: EncryptedPackage payload not a block multiple

O7_producer.where: crypt.go:505-509 (parseEncryptionInfo, xml.Unmarshal into Encryption, KeyData and EncryptedKey structs at crypt.go:56-104, ints unconstrained)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Agile password verification that decrypts encryptedVerifierHashInput/Value with the encryptedKey salt before the package key, adding a second call into decrypt with attacker-sized IV/ciphertext
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The struct fields already exist (crypt.go:100-101), and the current code never verifies the password, so a maintainer adding a proper wrong-password check would write exactly this.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: dataIntegrity HMAC check that decrypts encryptedHmacKey/encryptedHmacValue with an IV built by createIV from the keyData salt plus a fixed block key
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: DataIntegrity is parsed but unused. MS-OFFCRYPTO specifies this check, and it reuses createIV with a []byte block key (the branch at crypt.go:576), a route the published tests barely exercise.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A real RC4 CryptoAPI decrypt branch for the non-AES AlgID case, with its own verifier slicing and key-length derivation from header.KeySize
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The code already labels non-AES headers "RC4" and slices an RC4-sized verifier but still decrypts with AES, so adding the RC4 path is a natural feature completion and would be a second implementation in a separate file.

O9_family: unchecked untrusted length/size fields in a binary/XML container parser causing runtime panics (index out of range, divide by zero, CBC IV/blocks length panic); CWE-248 uncaught exception

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.0 modules (go.mod:3); deps richardlehane/mscfb, golang.org/x/crypto, x/text, testify
O10_build.project_tests: crypt_test.go TestEncrypt, TestEncryptionMechanism; excelize_test.go encrypted-file open tests (excelize_test.go:312-320); fixtures test/encryptSHA1.xlsx, test/encryptSHA512.xlsx, test/encryptAES.xlsx

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a defer/recover in Decrypt (or openReaderAt) that turns any panic into ErrWorkbookFileFormat, or bounds-check only the standardDecrypt header slice that the reproducer hits.

out_of_scope_notes: Panics inside the third-party mscfb reader (mscfb.New/Next/Read at crypt.go:145-206) are outside this repository.
Decrypt reads raw[26:28] (crypt.go:150) without its own length check; it relies on mscfb.New rejecting short input, not checked here.
Panics in the post-decryption zip/XML workbook parsing (ReadZipReader, excelize.go:223) are a different protection and were not pursued.
unverified: Whether mscfb.New always rejects input shorter than 28 bytes, which would make crypt.go:150 safe.
Whether the unchanged assertion at crypt_test.go:69-71 (standardDecrypt on a modified agile EncryptionInfo buffer returns NoError) still holds after the fix's new KeySize/size checks; not run.
recall_risk: published 2026-10-08, after this model's knowledge cutoff; write-up breadth not checked (no network).

No O8 route found: every unguarded slice, divisor or cipher call I traced on the Decrypt path at the pinned commit is touched by the fix; Encrypt-side code (crypt.go:346-404) only handles trusted, constant-shaped data.
